description: as seastate_2d_refraction with 3 threads (A 798 3, Phase 13), spectral sparsity (A 795 1e-6) and second-order geographic fluxes (A 796 2): the sweeps go over tiles of cells, a tile once its two upwind tiles are solved, the cells of a tile in the serial order; the first visits of the cells and the Hs of the stationary test shared out to the threads; bitwise the same case with one thread. Validation in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/57_threads_tiles.
